name: DORADO — Measurement & Verification Agent
description: Independent AI-governance MEASUREMENT body. Produces and verifies signed measurement cards, SCITT receipts and RFC 3161 time-anchors. A measurement credential is NOT a certification, endorsement or conformity mark.

measure.description: Deterministic GSPC measurement (no LLM judges another LLM); emits a signed card.

verify.description: Stranger-verify a signed card with only the published Ed25519 key.

verifyReceipt.description: Verify an SCITT (RFC 9943) receipt and bind it to a card.

verifyAnchor.description: Verify an RFC 3161 external time-anchor (TSA imprint-match).

elo.description: Rank models from pairwise results (Elo/Bradley-Terry + CI).

compare.description: Compare two models on the relative (pairwise) governance axes + cost.

register: This is a measurement credential. It is not a certification, endorsement, or conformity mark, and must not be presented as one.
